instruction: Repair adapter.parse_port(text) while preserving frozen legacy_parser.py and error_contract.json byte-for-byte. Accept one to five ASCII digits representing an integer in 1..65535; return the integer. Reject every other string, including whitespace, signs, zero, and too-long spellings, with the built-in ValueError rather than leaking legacy KeyError. Inputs are strings. Only adapter.py may change; use the standard library. Changing the public exception type or widening the accepted syntax is not a solution.
